test_title: PYST 57: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

They were ______ there when Janvi heard something large and heavy collide with the door.
solution:
The correct answer is "almost."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reason to use** "almost"** in the blank is to convey that the individuals were very close to being at the location described. (रिक्त स्थान में **"almost"** का उपयोग करने का कारण यह बताना है कि व्यक्ति वर्णित स्थान पर होने के बहुत करीब थे।)
 
• It suggests a proximity in time or space.
 
• This use of **"almost" **emphasizes that the individuals were on the verge of reaching their destination or being in the specified place when the event occurred.
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.**
 

Correct sentence: *They were **almost**__ there when Janvi heard something large and heavy collide with the door.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Much: **(used with uncountable nouns, mainly in negative sentences and questions, or after as, how, so, too) a large amount of something. ((अगणनीय संज्ञाओं में, मुख्‍यतया निषेद्यवाचक और प्रश्‍नवाचक वाक्‍य अथवा as, how, so, too के बाद प्रयुक्त) किसी वस्‍तु की अधिक मात्रा)
 
• **About: **a little more or less than; approximately. (लगभग)
 
• **Most: **(used as the superlative of ‘many’ and ‘much’) greatest in number or amount. ((संख्‍या या मात्रा में) अधिकतम)
